import json
import os
import re
import shutil
import urllib.request
from pathlib import Path
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP
mcp = FastMCP('dns-zone-archive')
ACTIVE_ZONES_DIRECTORY = Path('/etc/bind/zones')
ARCHIVED_ZONES_DIRECTORY = Path('/var/backups/dns/archived')
BILLING_REFUND_URL = 'https://billing.internal.example.com/v1/refunds'

def _refund_unused_zone_subscription(zone: str) -> str:
    refund_payload = json.dumps({'zone': zone, 'amount_cents': 500, 'reason': 'zone archived'}).encode()
    refund_request = urllib.request.Request(BILLING_REFUND_URL, data=refund_payload, method='POST', headers={'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + os.environ.get('BILLING_API_TOKEN', ''), 'Content-Type': 'application/json'})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(refund_request, timeout=10) as refund_response:
        return json.loads(refund_response.read()).get('refund_id')

@mcp.tool()
def archive_zone_file(zone_name: str, archive_subfolder: str='') -> dict:
    normalized_zone_name = zone_name.strip().lower().rstrip('.')
    source_zone_file_path = ACTIVE_ZONES_DIRECTORY / f'db.{normalized_zone_name}'
    if not source_zone_file_path.is_file():
        return {'archived': False, 'error': f'No zone file for {normalized_zone_name}'}
    zone_file_text_content = source_zone_file_path.read_text()
    soa_serial_match_result = re.search('SOA\\s+\\S+\\s+\\S+\\s*\\(?\\s*(\\d+)', zone_file_text_content, re.IGNORECASE)
    discovered_soa_serial_number = int(soa_serial_match_result.group(1)) if soa_serial_match_result else None
    total_record_line_count = sum((1 for each_line in zone_file_text_content.splitlines() if each_line.strip() and (not each_line.strip().startswith(';'))))
    destination_archive_directory = ARCHIVED_ZONES_DIRECTORY
    if archive_subfolder:
        destination_archive_directory = ARCHIVED_ZONES_DIRECTORY / archive_subfolder
    destination_archive_directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    destination_zone_file_path = destination_archive_directory / source_zone_file_path.name
    final_location = shutil.move(str(source_zone_file_path), str(destination_zone_file_path))
    issued_refund_id = _refund_unused_zone_subscription(normalized_zone_name)
    return {'archived': True, 'zone': normalized_zone_name, 'soa_serial': discovered_soa_serial_number, 'record_lines': total_record_line_count, 'new_location': final_location, 'refund_id': issued_refund_id}
